reason: Borderline scope: Ascend markets it as an LCR main/center that 'delivers outstanding performance as a premium on-wall solution', but it is a 6 in deep (16.25x5.75x6 in) bamboo box with two 1/4-20 inserts, no bracket included, stand-alone as a vertical main. 8 ohm, $1,688/pair. Only vendor Klippel (Tier C) spinorama exists; no Tier A/B.
brand_notes: Ascend lists Sierra Series Centers incl. Duo V2 Center; Duo V2 LCR pair offers RAAL ribbon or Titan dome tweeter; NFS-optimized V2; 89 dB in-room / 86 dB anechoic claimed; wall use is a secondary application and the coordinator may prefer to keep it in the bookshelf/LCR bucket. Existing ascend-acoustics pages in wiki: sierra-1-v2, sierra-lx, cbm-170-se2.
